`provenance.json` records the original byte count and SHA-256, patched prefix, final bundle, reversible effect-injection patches and companion hashes. `scripts/provenance.mjs` reverses the patches and checks the original bytes without an external source checkout.

`package.json` is **metadata only** for native version lookup. It is an incomplete upstream package: most declared `dist` exports and binaries are deliberately absent. Do not install or run scripts in this directory. Root dependency installation does not consume this manifest.
